description: A shell script for building, tagging, and publishing Docker images for different Ubuntu versions and architectures, including attaching end-of-life manifests.

methods.name: tag_and_push
methods.description: Tags a Docker image and pushes it to a registry, then attaches an end-of-life manifest.

methods.name: attach_eol_manifest
methods.description: Attaches an end-of-life manifest to a Docker image using oras.

methods.name: install_oras_if_needed
methods.description: Downloads and installs the oras tool if it is not already available.

methods.name: publish_docker_images_with_arch_suffix
methods.description: Builds and pushes Docker images for a specific flavor and architecture.

methods.name: publish_docker_manifest
methods.description: Creates and pushes Docker manifests for multi-architecture images.
